about_blocks.text: About Living Potential Inc.: Sober Living in Calgary
about_blocks.html: About Living Potential Inc.: Sober Living in Calgary

about_blocks.text: Living Potential Inc. runs a sober living house in Calgary for adults moving away from alcohol and drug addiction. It describes itself as a safe, supportive living environment, and that is what it is: a home. It does not offer detox, medical care, counselling or a treatment program on site, so most people use it alongside meetings and outside supports, or after finishing treatment somewhere else.
about_blocks.html: Living Potential Inc. runs a sober living house in Calgary for adults moving away from alcohol and drug addiction. It describes itself as a safe, supportive living environment, and that is what it is: a home. It does not offer detox, medical care, counselling or a treatment program on site, so most people use it alongside meetings and outside supports, or after finishing treatment somewhere else.

about_blocks.text: Every guest gets a private, fully furnished room with fresh bedding and a new smart TV. The kitchen, living areas and bathrooms are shared. Groceries and household supplies are included in the rent, the fridge and pantry are kept stocked, and there are pre-made meals in the freezer for whenever someone gets home. Wi-Fi comes with the room, along with Netflix, Disney+, Prime and Crave.

about_blocks.text: The house is set up for people who work. Night shift and day shift schedules are both fine, and guests are strongly encouraged to hold a job, go to school or take on some steady daily responsibility. Living Potential also pushes the basics that tend to help people stay sober: regular recovery meetings, a sponsor, and contact with a psychologist or other support in the community. Its recovery.com profile lists an introduction to the 12-step program and AA and NA meetings.

about_blocks.text: The owners say they spent a few years running the house quietly while they worked out how they wanted to do it. What they settled on is more flexible than a lot of recovery housing. Each guest is handled case by case, with freedom balanced against accountability and no judgement about where someone is starting from.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Living Potential Inc.

faqs.question: Is Living Potential Inc. a treatment centre?

answer_blocks.text: No. Living Potential Inc. is a sober living house in Calgary, which it describes as a safe, supportive living environment for people in recovery. There is no detox, medical care or clinical treatment on site. Guests get a sober, structured place to live while they work, study and use meetings and outside supports.

faqs.question: How much does Living Potential cost?

answer_blocks.text: Rooms cost $1,400, $1,500 or $1,600 a month, depending on the room, according to the Living Potential website. Every price includes food and management costs. The centre's recovery.com profile says it is private pay, and no insurance coverage is listed.

answer_blocks.text: All rooms are private and furnished. The large room has a queen bed, dresser, closet and smart TV for $1,600 a month. answer_blocks.text: Yes, and Living Potential encourages it. The house accommodates both night shift and day shift schedules. Guests are strongly encouraged to find work, go to school or take on regular daily responsibilities.

faqs.question: Where is Living Potential in Calgary?

answer_blocks.text: The house is in Calgary, Alberta. The website and Google listing do not publish a street address, so you get the location when you contact the house. Airdrie is roughly 20 to 30 minutes from Calgary, and Red Deer is about 1.5 hours up Highway 2.
